caseNameFull: Koon v. United States and Powell v. United States

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 515 U. S. 1190.] Motion of petitioner Stacey Koon for divided argument denied. Motion of petitioner Laurence Powell for divided argument granted, and the time is divided as follows: petitioner Koon, 15 minutes; petitioner Powell, 15 minutes.
